Name: It's An Earthy Reshade
Author: lungora
Description:
This is a reshade preset, it needs [url=https://reshade.me/]Reshade[/url]﻿ to work. Inside the file there is simply a .ini . When installing reshade it will prompt you to select one, this is when you do it. If you have reshade you likely already know how to select a new preset. If you're installing reshade for the first time make sure to secelct OpenGL.


I downloaded the fantastic new [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20666]Actually Blue Stardew Reshade[/url] preset because my usual visual look of DaisyNiko's Earth Recolour isnt updated for 1.6. But it was too bright, so I dimmed it a bit but dark blue wasnt my thing and I figured if I'm customising why not get the game looking as close to how I like it nice and earthy as I could so I did. Then I shared, someone suggested I make a mod page, here we are.

In my screenshots I'm using the wonderful [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14027]Sakura Interface Redux[/url], it's not 100% up to 1.6 with some of the cool new UI but it's working well for me give it a look! I'm also running Stardew Valley Expanded, which is why the town looks a bit different.

Anyways with the reshade things are mostly awesome, the UI is a lil dark at parts because of how reshades look and caves are pretty dark too where theres no light sources so find your glow rings! Part of the deal of reshades that, but if anyone has suggestions on tweaks I'd love to hear them.
